paragraphs: Markets over the last day: the eight tracked equity indices moved -0.37% on average, with Hang Seng strongest (+0.69%) and Dow Jones weakest (-1.23%). Brent crude changed -1.30% to 111.7. Gold changed -1.29% to 4,007.8999. Bitcoin changed -0.81% to 80,137.4922. The US 10-year yield stands at 4.988%, a relative move of +0.71%. Among the firms tracked, Equinor (+5.17%) and Newmont (-4.59%) moved the most.

Deals and capital markets: Musk’s bet of the century (FT Companies). The proposed Tesla-SpaceX merger is going all in on AI Deals and capital markets: US executives quit $25bn gas venture over claims of secret Russian control (FT Markets). Former CEO of Polar Train LNG tells FT that energy giant Novatek financed and held reins of strategic Alaska project without Washington’s approval Central banks and macro: Israeli central bank rejects Netanyahu’s plan to use crypto to evade sanctions (FT World). Critics say prime minister’s proposal would turn country into an economic pariah Geopolitics and trade: The right’s obsession with ‘civil war’ in Britain (FT World). Many of those stoking fears of bloody unrest don’t actually live in the country Geopolitics and trade: Mercuria challenging the ‘Dow Jones of shipping’ in court after Hormuz losses (FT World). Case will test the Baltic Exchange’s decision to keep publishing price estimates for shipping oil through the Strait of Hormuz during the war
